sound_intent.overall_character: Aggressive, raw, hook-heavy boom bap with a mainstream appeal, making prominent use of chopped sample layers to create energy and groove.

routing_intent.routing_preferences: Separate channels for each sample chop technique layer to allow detailed mixing control and automation.

track_roles.drums: Rhythmic backbone using chopped vintage samples.
track_roles.bass: Supportive low-end with chopped groove segments.
track_roles.chords: Harmonic texture using looped chord chops.
track_roles.melody: Hook and fill elements via chopped melodic samples.
track_roles.fx: Rhythmic and transitional effects using chopped scratch samples.

designer_intent.instruction: Create an arrangement emphasizing aggressive energy during hooks with clear, rhythmic chopped sample layers reflecting traditional boom bap production style with a mainstream variation.

presetor_intent.instruction: Focus on routing and mixing presets that enhance sample chop clarity and maintain aggression and energy in hooks.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns using chopped vintage breakbeat samples and granular slicing techniques to maintain aggressive boom bap feel.

bass_generator.brief: Produce bassline segments chopped for rhythmic interest supporting groove without overshadowing drums.

harmony_generator.brief: Create chord chops that add harmonic texture and syncopation aligned with boom bap style.

melody_generator.brief: Provide melodic hooks and fills using sliced melodic sample chops capturing aggressive mood.

ai_designer.brief: Design arrangement structure featuring energy peaks at hooks and smooth transitions between sections using chopped samples.

presetor.brief: Apply mixing and routing presets emphasizing sample chop separation and energy dynamics.

songgps.brief: Track arrangement energy and section mapping to optimize hook prominence within a boom bap context.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix individual chopped sample layers preserving clarity and aggression while maintaining balanced energy.
